display.purpose: Page titles only. One Georgia serif heading per surface; its scarcity is the point.

headline.purpose: Section heads inside a page. 15px semibold sans, tighter cut than body Inter.

body.purpose: Default text. 13px / 20px line-height. The working tier brokers scan all day.

label.purpose: Eyebrow labels in modals and section markers. Use sparingly; not default scaffolding.

shadows.name: whisper
shadows.purpose: Default. Buttons, inputs, cards at rest. Hairline below the element to separate it from Mistral.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Hover state on actionable cards. Subtle; the motion does more work than the shadow.

shadows.name: inner-glow
shadows.purpose: Bottom inner highlight on .btn-primary only. Gives the CTA its single-hue gradient depth.

shadows.name: primary-cta
shadows.purpose: External shadow on .btn-primary. A touch deeper than Whisper to give the CTA weight.

motion.name: ease-out-default
motion.purpose: Default for state transitions: button hover, card lift, focus ring.

motion.name: ease-out-snappy
motion.purpose: Nav items, sidebar toggle, status pill swaps.

motion.name: ease-out-modal
motion.purpose: Modal enter/exit. Quart easing, no bounce.

motion.name: shake-error
motion.purpose: Input shake on submit failure (wrong password, wrong OTP). Reduced-motion: instant border flash.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Single primary CTA per surface. Bureau Vert with a single-hue gradient and inset bottom highlight.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Inline actions in cards and rows. Transparent until hovered.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #5c5953; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease-out, color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #F8F6F2; color: #22201a; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00a272; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field. 38px tall, 8px radius, Whisper inner shadow.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #22201a; border: 1px solid #e2dfd8; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0px 1px 2px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 20px; outline: none; transition: border-color 200ms ease-out, box-shadow 200ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #85827b; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(0,162,114,0.4); box-shadow: 0px 1px 2px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), 0 0 0 2px rgba(0,162,114,0.2); }

narrative.overview: A French insurance broker's office in good order. Wood, warm paper, dark green binding, one signal lamp on the desk. The system carries authority through restraint: a single warm-neutral surface, two greens that never compete, a serif voice for page titles, and tight 13px sans-serif rows of broker-grade data. Density is the affordance; brokers scan hundreds of fields a day, and the design earns its keep by being legible at a glance without ornament. The system explicitly rejects the SaaS dashboard reflex: no neon dark mode, no playful animations, no gradient text, no glassmorphism, no identical card grids, no 01/02/03 scaffolding above every section. Warmth is carried by the off-white Mistral surface and the serif page titles, not by tinted near-white cream backgrounds. The product looks like a tool a senior partner would keep open all day, not a deck.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-neutral surface (Mistral, #faf8f5) carries 80%+ of every screen.
Two greens that never share a surface: bright Signal Vert (#00a272) for status and links, deep Bureau Vert (#1A3C34) for the single primary CTA.
Serif page titles in Georgia (24px), sans section heads in Inter Display (15px / 600), body in Inter (13px / 20px line-height).
Borders are 1px, warm gray Linen Edge (#eae7e0). Shadows are whisper-soft.
French copy. Sober, specific. No marketing buzzwords, no aphoristic cadence.

rules.name: The Two Greens Rule
rules.body: Signal Vert and Bureau Vert never share a surface. Signal Vert is for state (success, active, link); Bureau Vert is the primary CTA color and nothing else.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Per screen, only one of Signal Vert, Cuivre, Bordeaux is the dominant accent. Status pills can coexist as data, but decorative use of two accents on the same canvas is forbidden.

rules.name: The Warm-Neutral Doctrine
rules.body: Mistral is the room. Document White is the page on the desk. Together they carry 80%+ of every screen.

rules.name: The Serif-Once Rule
rules.body: Georgia appears for the page title. It does not appear in modals, cards, buttons, or repeated headings. Its scarcity is the point.

rules.name: The 13px Body Rule
rules.body: Body is 13px / 1.4. Smaller sizes (11–12px) are for labels and metadata and need a reason. Larger sizes (15px+) are heads or eyebrow titles, not body.

rules.name: The All-Caps Cap
rules.body: Uppercase is permitted only at the label tier (11px tracked). No body sentences in caps, no card titles in caps, no buttons in caps.

rules.name: The Whisper Rule
rules.body: Default shadows are 1px / 2px blur / 5% black. If a shadow needs to pop, the design is louder than the brand.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is borders before shadows. A 1px Linen Edge is the first tool; a Whisper shadow is the second. Heavier shadows only earn their place on floating surfaces.

dos: Do use Mistral (#faf8f5) as the body surface on every page.
Do reserve Bureau Vert (#1A3C34) for the single primary CTA per surface. One per screen, period.
Do use Signal Vert (#00a272) for status, links, and active nav, sparingly.
Do keep borders at 1px Linen Edge (#eae7e0). Hierarchy is borders before shadows.
Do keep body at 13px / 1.4 Inter. Smaller sizes need a reason.
Do use Georgia serif for page titles (24px) and only page titles.
Do write French copy that names what's happening. Sober, specific, never hyped.
Do make every AI action visible: timeline, status pill, named step.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for the live-agent feeds and the streaming background blobs.
Do verify 4.5:1 contrast for body text and placeholders against Mistral and Document White.
donts: Don't add a second primary CTA on a surface. The Bureau Vert button is singular.
Don't mix Signal Vert and Bureau Vert on the same element. They are not interchangeable greens.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe accent.
Don't use gradient text. Solid color, weight + size for emphasis.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. The modal backdrop is the only blur surface.
Don't import a component library (shadcn, MUI, Chakra). Every primitive is custom.
Don't name a future neutral token --paper, --cream, --sand, --bone, --linen, or --parchment. Mistral is the system's name.
Don't put a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section.
Don't number sections with 01 / 02 / 03 as default scaffolding.
Don't use bouncy/spring/elastic motion. Ease-out curves only.
Don't clone Linear, Notion, or a SaaS hero-metric dashboard.
Don't use neon dark mode, multi-stop gradient buttons, or emoji-driven empty states.
